Definition: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
BiblicalUsage: 1) standing place, place; 1a) standing place, station, post, office; 1b) place, place of human abode; 1c) city, land, region; 1d) place, locality, spot; 1e) space, room, distance; 1f) region, quarter, direction; 1g) give place to, instead of
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
